The tray holds several items. "On the plate" is ambiguous, so I estimated the whole meal.

- Plate: avocado (about 3 slices, roughly half an avocado, ~70 g, ~110 kcal) and one egg, poached or fried (~50 g, ~90 kcal).
- Muffin (savory, ~70 g, ~200 kcal).
- Yogurt cup (~150 g, ~130 kcal).
- Coffee with milk (~250 g, ~40 kcal).

Totals: 110 + 90 + 200 + 130 + 40 = 570 kcal. Mass: 70 + 50 + 70 + 150 + 250 = 590 g.
